title: Montessori-informed care

pairs.key: Montessori approach: before choosing an activity, first ___ the baby’s interests and cues.
Montessori calls a thoughtfully arranged, development-appropriate space the prepared ___.
Infant floor movement and tummy time belong in supervised ___ time, not sleep time.
Montessori-informed conversation: respond to baby’s sounds, then pause so you can take ___.

context: Memory practice, not medical advice or certification of hands-on care. Follow the baby’s clinician for individual needs. Karp is an optional soothing framework; Montessori is an educational approach. Safety guidance takes precedence. Sources checked 2026-11-02. Observation supports responsive choices, not ignoring distress or postponing feeding/medical care. For awake play: simple, orderly and safe, with appropriate materials. Parenting philosophy does not replace sleep-safety standards. Provide safe floor space and stay attentive. Follow the baby’s tolerance; do not prescribe a fixed duration from the Montessori page. Warm face-to-face talk during ordinary routines; no need for special products or claims of accelerated development.
